sources.title: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5
sources.snippet: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5 is a Behavior World Model for robust humanoid whole-body control with environment interaction, implausible commands, and fall recovery.

sources.title: open-gigaai/GigaBrain-WBC-0.5-TerrainData - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Training and benchmark data for GigaBrain-WBC-0.5, a behavior world model for robust humanoid whole-body tracking with environment interaction. The data ships as two uncompressed tar archives rather than as a loose file tree, because the tree holds ~29k files that average only a few kilobytes each ...
